Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Style: ink: edge colour drawn over the posterized image as lines. neon: dimmed image with an additive glowing edge and hot white core.
Levels: Number of brightness bands in the posterize (2-16). Hue and saturation are kept.
Posterizesoft: Softness of the transitions between brightness bands. 0 = hard steps, higher = smoother blends.
Edgecolor: Colour of the ink line or neon glow.
Edgewidth: Edge detection tap distance in pixels. Larger values give thicker, coarser lines. Boosted by band1 modulation.
Threshold: Edge strength cutoff. Higher values keep only strong edges, lower values pick up fine detail and noise.
Edgesoft: Width of the soft transition at the threshold. 0 = hard aliased lines, higher = softer lines.
Colorweight: Edge source blend: 0 = brightness-only edges, 1 = colour-gradient edges (catches hue changes).
Glowsize: Blur size in pixels of the neon glow. Only used by the neon style.
Glowamount: Gain of the neon glow. Boosted by the beat modulation input. Only used by the neon style.
Dim: Neon style: brightness of the underlying image (0 = black, 1 = unchanged).
Look: Test-source only (when in1 is unconnected): original keeps the colourful test shapes, mono switches to black/bone-white greys.
Accent: Test-source mono look only (when in1 is unconnected): 0-1 tints one test object red. No effect on a connected in1.
